title: Nainis kami! — Debt watch group hits Cayetano's push for citizens to pay government debt
summary: The Freedom from Debt Coalition said the proposal wrongly assumes Filipinos are not yet paying for state borrowings, and ignores differences in citizens' financial capacities.
